The '''Gelgelar system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].

The Gelgelar system contained the planet [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]].<ref name="PSG" /> It was also the location of the [[XQ5 Platform]] [[Hormuuz]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hospital facility during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Hormuuz was [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|captured]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]]'s [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] and subsequently used as a staging point for their [[Imperial Task Force Vengeance|operations]] into the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]].<ref name="BoP" />
